description: Reversi (Othello) with full flipping rules, pass handling and a greedy max-flip AI.

faqs.a: If you have no legal move on your turn, you must pass — the game does this automatically and tells you. If neither player can move, the game ends and discs are counted.
faqs.q: What happens if I have no legal move?

faqs.a: The computer evaluates every legal move and picks the one that flips the most discs, with a strong preference for corners. It's beatable — mobility matters more than disc count early on.
Disc count only matters at the end. Early on, having fewer discs is often better because it gives you more moves. Corners can never be flipped — fight for them.

howto: You play black — click a highlighted square to place a disc.
You must outflank white discs; all flipped discs turn black.
If you can't move, you pass automatically.
Most discs when neither side can move wins.
title: Reversi
